method: Compare documented task capture and project organization on both official sites. Classify only this bounded workflow alternative; exclude team/platform/full replacement guarantees. The user confirmed this comparison scope, not publication or hands-on testing.

anchorSource.statement: Official features document task capture and grouping tasks into projects; collaboration is separately described.

candidates.statement: Official overview describes personal tasks, day planning and projects.
candidates.limits: Apple-only applications; platforms sold separately; real-time shared lists unsupported.

candidates.statement: Official features describe capturing actions in Inbox and organizing them into projects.
candidates.limits: Native Apple edition only; Web subscription and future major upgrades are separate.

candidates.statement: Official site documents native tasks, lists, checklists and projects with sub-tasks.
candidates.limits: Mobile purchases and future update entitlement are separate; Todoist sync is not proof of independent replacement.
